precommit.decisions: month starts 00:00 UTC; first = first month with >= 10 eligible vaults in u100k; last = 2026-09-01
precommit.holding: from the vault's first grid point >= t to its first grid point >= next month start
precommit.eligibility: relationship normal (HLP parent/children and vaults led by the HLP leader excluded); first funded point <= t - 6 months; equity at the last point <= t >= the universe threshold

signals.ret3: trailing 3-month time-weighted return (index at last point <= t over index at last point <= t-3m)
signals.sharpe6: mean / sd of grid-step returns in (t-6m, t], annualised by the vault's step length (>= 4 steps)
signals.mdd6: minus the max drawdown of the return index over [t-6m, t] (shallower drawdown ranks higher)
signals.flow3: net deposits less withdrawals over (t-3m, t] over equity at t-3m
signals.tvlg3: equity at t over equity at t-3m, minus 1 (flows and P&L together)

weights.cw: weight proportional to equity at t (capacity-weighted)

precommit.fee: leaderCommission on follower equity above cost basis, crystallised pro rata on withdrawal (simulated follower account); deposits and withdrawals free; friction 10bp of turnover as a sensitivity
precommit.choice: backtest.choose_then_test on monthly net excess over the savings rate paid, frac 0.5, key sharpe
precommit.go_rule: go only if the chosen variant earns > +2%/yr net over the savings rate paid out of sample with Newey-West t > 2, BH-adjusted out-of-sample p < 0.10 across all variants, and capacity >= $1M today
precommit.kill_if_go: trailing 6-month net excess < 0, or selected vaults' follower room < $1M, or a selected vault closes after a > 20% loss inside a month

note: written before any forward return was computed; analyze() checks this hash
